description: Position des bus en circulation sur le réseau STAR en temps réel is a dataset listed in Rennes-metropole open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by STAR. ATTENTION: Pour une utilisation fréquente de ce dataset, nous vous invitons à vous connecter directement à la plateforme Kéolis ici: Liste des positions des bus utilisés sur réseau STAR en temps réel, comprenant notamment la ligne et la destination éventuelle sur laquelle ils circulent. Coverage: Rennes Métropole. The portal files it under Mobilité, Transport. Its keywords are bus, temps réel. The portal shows 427 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2014-11-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-rennesmetropole-fr-portal.
